admission.justification: A unit test proves typing.get_type_hints resolves the public outside_scratch field instead of failing on class-body shadowing of the outside_scratch module.

applicability: Class-scope type annotation resolution on EnclosurePublicationArtifacts in lifecycle_operation_location.py.
conditions: Runtime or static callers resolve annotations on EnclosurePublicationArtifacts via typing.get_type_hints.
statement: EnclosurePublicationArtifacts keeps its public outside_scratch field while importing the outside_scratch module under an alias so typing.get_type_hints resolves outside_scratch in class scope.
title: EnclosurePublicationArtifacts aliases outside_scratch for type hints
